name: Fig Tree Bridge
facts: The current Fig Tree Bridge opened in September 1963, designed with extra width to accommodate two future lanes, a feature evident in its off‑centre camber that hints at a planned North Western Expressway.
Before the concrete girder, an iron truss swing bridge opened in 1885; its opening wheel, once capable of a full hour rotation, now stands as a memorial on the southern abutment.
Fig Tree Bridge is a key link in the Seven Bridges Walk, a Cancer Council NSW fundraising route that traverses seven iconic Sydney bridges, including the Harbour and Pyrmont bridges.
